data.name: A Haunting Novel: Burton Hotel Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Elephant Games proudly presents the first game in a new spine-tingling hidden-object series with A Haunting Novel: Burton Hotel!

Welcome to the Burton Hotel! Left to the family’s last member after the patriarch’s passing, this sprawling mansion-turned-hotel is ready to be shined up, cleaned out, and put up for sale. There’s just one problem – the hotel and family’s intertwined history is coming back in strange and terrifying ways! Mysterious apparitions from a dark past spread through the corridors of the manor as you struggle to untangle and understand the secrets of a family torn apart by grief. Are you brave enough to venture into the unknown? Your life and the spirits of the past, present, and future may depend on it!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Join Valorie Aster in exorcizing her Manor House of an evil spirit and making it safe for orphan children.

  • Make your way through the darkness with the handy strategy guide!

  • Tons of extras, including hotel collectibles, hidden books, achievements, and a haunted bonus puzzle.

  • Downloadable wallpapers perfect a terrifically terrifying atmosphere!

  • Bring the adventure home with the exclusive music player!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
